judged_text: In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response whose `.data` property is undefined, but the very next statement `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` assumes the axios-response shape of the non-shared branch. The first Zoho Bigin token refresh with sharing enabled throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error')`, so every Bigin calendar operation that needs a fresh token crashes instead of refreshing.

record.issue_text: [BUG] In sharing mode refreshOAuthTokens returns a fetch Response whose `.data` property is undefined, but the very next statement `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` assumes the axios-response shape of the non-shared branch. The first Zoho Bigin token refresh with sharing enabled throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error')`, so every Bigin calendar operation that needs a fresh token crashes instead of refreshing.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy, the function unconditionally performs `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` and returns the resulting `Response` object. In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `tokenInfo` is assigned from `await refreshOAuthTokens(async () => await axios.post(...), "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` and then immediately used as an Axios response via `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)`. In sharing mode, `tokenInfo` will be a Fetch `Response` (no `.data`), so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a `TypeError`, matching the finding.
